subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Mental maths (number range 20)
source.subtopic: Rapid recall of number bonds and addition and subtraction facts to 8 (weeks 1-4), 9 (weeks 5-6) and 10 (weeks 7-10)

show.line: Quick sums to eight! Six plus two? Eight! Eight minus three? Five! Fast as you can.

rounds.prompt: Quick! Four plus four. Say the answer.
Quick! Seven minus two. Say the answer.
Does the answer make eight or seven? Sort the sums.

hints: Think of the bond. Five and three make eight.
Doubles are quick. Four and four is eight.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Quick! Eight minus five.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Five and three make eight. Eight minus five is three.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count up from five. Six, seven, eight. Three!

parent_line: Knows the adding and taking away facts to 8 quickly.
